title: Intellicare unveils vision for next wave of healthcare impact as it celebrates 31 years of trusted care
summary: For Intellicare’s more than 1.3 million members across the Philippines—comprising both principals and their enrolled dependents—access to quality, affordable, and dependable healthcare remains…

blocks.text: For Intellicare’s more than 1.3 million members across the Philippines—comprising both principals and their enrolled dependents—access to quality, affordable, and dependable healthcare remains essential to their well-being. As Intellicare celebrates its 31st anniversary, the company reaffirms its commitment to meeting these needs while shaping the future of healthcare through innovation, responsibility, and trust.

Guided by its anniversary theme, “Creating the Next Wave of Care: Scaling Impact Through Trusted Care,” Intellicare enters a new chapter focused on transforming three decades of experience and established trust into greater value for its members, clients, healthcare providers, and partners.

For 31 years, Intellicare has continuously evolved alongside the changing needs of the healthcare landscape. What began as a mission to provide accessible and dependable healthcare solutions has grown into a healthcare ecosystem built on strong partnerships, operational excellence, and a steadfast commitment to care.

Today, as healthcare continues to transform, Intellicare is focused on creating the next wave of care by expanding access to quality healthcare, embracing innovation, advancing sustainable and responsible practices, and strengthening the trust that has defined its relationships with stakeholders over the years.

“Thirty-one years is more than Intellicare’s milestone. It is a reminder of the trust that our members, clients, healthcare providers, and partners have placed in us through the years,” said Intellicare President Jeremy Matti. “As we celebrate this important anniversary, we remain focused on driving meaningful impact through trusted care and creating solutions that will help improve healthcare experiences for generations to come.”

Throughout the anniversary year, Intellicare will highlight initiatives that reflect its commitment to improving healthcare access, pursuing innovation, promoting responsible growth, and strengthening stakeholder confidence.
These efforts represent Intellicare’s continued dedication to delivering healthcare solutions that respond to the evolving needs of the communities it serves.
As it looks ahead, Intellicare remains guided by the belief that meaningful healthcare impact begins with trust.
By working closely with members, clients, healthcare providers, partners, and communities, Intellicare aims to create lasting value and contribute to a healthier future for all.

In keeping with the spirit of gratitude and appreciation, the anniversary was celebrated simply and modestly through a recognition program for its valued talents, honoring service awardees and individuals who demonstrated excellence across various categories.

The event was held on November 23 at Intellicare’s Head Office in Makati City, bringing together employees and members of the leadership team. To ensure that the celebration could be shared with colleagues across the country, the program was also livestreamed for employees in regional offices nationwide.

Reflecting on Intellicare’s founding vision, Intellicare Chairman Mario Silos shared his optimism for the future and expressed his confidence in the next generation of leaders who will carry the organization into its next chapter.

“This 31st year signals for me a new wave. It is no longer a matter of survival for us, nor just about growing further. It is a transformation. We now have the capacity as a leader in the HMO industry to help shape the future,” he said.

He added that the next generation of Intellicare talents will be the new wave of care, strengthening the connections that define the organization while advancing innovation and impact for the years ahead.
From leading the ripple of care to creating the next wave of care, Intellicare celebrates 31 years of service with gratitude, purpose, and a renewed commitment to driving impact through trusted care.
This article is brought to you by Intellicare.
